contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_email_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `history_items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `email_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_email_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `history_items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `email_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_email_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `history_items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `email_fts`(`docid`, `subject`, `sender_email`, `sender_name`, `recipient_emails`, `recipient_names`, `body_preview`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`subject`, NEW.`sender_email`, NEW.`sender_name`, NEW.`recipient_emails`, NEW.`recipient_names`, NEW.`body_preview`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_email_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `history_items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `email_fts`(`docid`, `subject`, `sender_email`, `sender_name`, `recipient_emails`, `recipient_names`, `body_preview`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`subject`, NEW.`sender_email`, NEW.`sender_name`, NEW.`recipient_emails`, NEW.`recipient_names`, NEW.`body_preview`); END
